A clear first week for Velora

Start small. Share a useful first version, then let real feedback shape what comes next.

Monday · Get the message right

Define who this is for: independent consultants who want to turn scattered research into clear recommendations.

Wednesday · Share with a small group

Send a personal introduction to five potential customers. Include the notebook and ask what would make it more useful.

Friday · Decide what comes next

Collect the replies, look for repeated needs, and choose one improvement for next week.
